title: Defense and Veterans Center for Integrative Pain Management (DVCIPM) Pain Registry Biobank
official: Defense and Veterans Center for Integrative Pain Management (DVCIPM)Pain Registry Biobank
summary: This Pain Registry Biobank is a prospective cohort design study whereby data (PASTOR survey, blood and saliva specimens, clinical data) is collected from participants in a longitudinal fashion with continual enrollment.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Eligibile for care within the Military Healthcare System
* Able and willing to provide written consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* Cannot understand English
sponsor: Defense and Veterans Center for Integrative Pain Management
